issue.title: Inconsistent State on aws_lambda_function
issue.body:
### Terraform and AWS Provider Version

```console
terraform --version
Terraform v1.14.5
on darwin_arm64
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/archive v2.8.1
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws v6.66.0
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/azuread v3.10.0
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/random v3.9.1
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/time v0.14.2

Your version of Terraform is out of date! The latest version
is 1.16.4. You can update by downloading from https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/install
```

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

* `aws_lambda_function`

### Expected Behavior

I expected a successful apply. It was only changing the timeout

### Actual Behavior

It didnt apply successfully, but reported a provider bug.

### Relevant Error/Panic Output

```console
│ Error: Provider produced inconsistent final plan
│ 
│ When expanding the plan for module.agentcore.aws_lambda_function.tools_gateway_response_interceptor to include new values learned so far during apply, provider
│ "registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws" produced an invalid new value for .environment: block count changed from 0 to 1.
│ 
│ This is a bug in the provider, which should be reported in the provider's own issue tracker.
```


### Sample Terraform Configuration

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand configuration</summary>

Configuration:

```hcl
resource "aws_lambda_function" "tools_gateway_response_interceptor" {
  function_name = "${var.name}-tools-gateway-response-interceptor"
  role          = time_sleep.tools_gateway_interceptor_role_propagation.triggers["role_arn"]
  package_type  = "Image"
  image_uri     = local.base_container_image_uri
  architectures = ["arm64"]
  timeout       = 30

  environment {
    variables = {
      GUARDRAIL_ID      = aws_bedrock_guardrail.tool_output.guardrail_id
      GUARDRAIL_VERSION = aws_bedrock_guardrail_version.tool_output.version
      # What the UI asks the user to authorize when a token exchange fails for
      # lack of consent: the app the gateway exchanges tokens with
      CONSENT_SCOPE = format("api://%s/.default", azuread_application.agentcore.client_id)
    }
  }

  tags = merge(var.tags, {
    Name = "${var.name}-tools-gateway-response-interceptor"
  })

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [image_uri]
  }

  depends_on = [
    aws_ecr_repository_policy.base_container_lambda_pull,
  ]
}
```

This was the plan:

```
# module.agentcore.aws_lambda_function.tools_gateway_response_interceptor will be updated in-place
  ~ resource "aws_lambda_function" "tools_gateway_response_interceptor" {
        id                             = "agentcore-tools-gateway-response-interceptor"
        tags                           = {
            "Name"    = "agentcore-tools-gateway-response-interceptor"
            "Project" = "agentcore"
        }
      ~ timeout                        = 3 -> 30
        # (30 unchanged attributes hidden)

        # (3 unchanged blocks hidden)
    }

```
</details>


### Steps to Reproduce

On next apply it applied successfully, so I cant say I could reproduce it

### Debug Logging

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand log output</summary>

```console

```
</details>


### GenAI / LLM Assisted Development

claude code

### Important Facts and References

_No response_

### Would you like to implement a fix?

No
